faqs.a:
No tract in any sewer district shall be connected with the sewer district sewer unless
               before the completion of a pro-rata share of the estimated cost shall be, or after
               completion the assessment has been, paid, except that in cases where the cost of sewers
               is to be assessed upon property in a district and the payment therefor had been fixed
               by the council to be made in installments, then connections may be made at any time
               when deemed advisable by the engineer.
(Code 1981, § 27-132; Ord. No. 551, § 73, 5-14-1964)
